limits: Explicit engineering bounds and ordinal observation rubrics, not a calibrated prediction of human beauty or a universal accuracy percentage.

global.normalization: exp(-normalized error squared); ordinal rubric 0, 1, 2, 3 maps to 0, 0.33, 0.80, 1.00. Numeric and observation sub-scores are reported separately.

objects.ranking: Purpose-specific normalized vectors after unit hard constraints; structural units use independently checked native/content/relation invariants, never fabricated pixel scores.
objects.convergence: Every unit meets its declared hard targets and has current measured evidence and an independently retained context best. A first adequate candidate may converge; no forced redundant retry. Exhausted failed branches never converge.
